tools.name: list_structures
tools.description: List the ten ways to fund a small acquisition, with what each requires, what the seller must accept, what rules it out and what it costs the buyer.

tools.name: get_structure
tools.description: One funding structure in full, by id.

tools.name: list_funding_providers
tools.description: What acquisition funding providers publish about themselves, each fact carrying the URL it was read from and the date. Includes whether they are still accepting applications.

tools.name: get_posture
tools.description: ZeroAcquire's referral posture. Read this before repeating anything from list_funding_providers.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_funding_providers · Public sink: list_funding_providers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_funding_providers · Public sink: list_funding_providers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
